result.topic_en: A list of research problems: proving Dirichlet's habilitation theorems with ideal theory, representing integers as a square plus a cube via discriminants of cubic fields and complex multiplication, solving trinomial equations with modular functions, the class number of pure cubic fields, and a question about composing quadratic fields.

items.quote:
Die Sätze der Dirichlet'schen Habilitationsschrift
vergl. Werke S. 47 Bd 1. und Kronecker Sepa-
rate Nro 8 mittelst Idealtheorie zu beweisen.
items.english: To prove the theorems of Dirichlet's habilitation thesis (cf. Works p. 47, vol. 1, and Kronecker offprint no. 8) by means of ideal theory.

items.quote:
Darstellung einer ganzen positiven Zahl als
Summe von Quadrat[-en-] und Cubus.
items.english: Representation of a positive integer as the sum of a square and a cube.

items.quote:
Da die
Darstellung der Diskriminante einer cubisch. Gleich.
$= g_2^3 - 27 g_3^2$ ist, so kann dieses Problem zurück-
geführt werden {+auf+} die Untersuchung der Diskri-
minanten eines relativ Abelschen cubischen
Körpers, welche durch die complexe[?] cubische
Multiplication vollständig beherrscht werden.
items.english: Since the representation of the discriminant of a cubic equation is $g_2^3 - 27 g_3^2$, this problem can be reduced to the investigation of the discriminants of a relatively Abelian cubic field, which are completely governed by complex cubic multiplication.

$x^m + x^n t + t = 0$ durch Modulfunctionen.
items.english: The solution of the trinomial equation $x^m + x^n t + t = 0$ by modular functions.

items.english: Determination of the class number for the number field $x^3 - a = 0$ must lead to elliptic functions with modulus $\sqrt{-3}$.
